description: This file defines the 'Log' utility class that provides static methods for logging messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT). It acts as a wrapper and a bridge to Android's native logging system (`android.util.Log`), facilitating controlled and consistent logging across the app. It also manages a chain of LogNode objects for custom log handling.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for logging messages at various levels and managing a chain of LogNode objects to handle log output.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the logging chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates log message to the current LogNode with specified priority, tag, message, and throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level, with optional Throwable.
